decisions.decision: Public positioning focuses on an independent GTA V multiplayer platform, not SaaS terminology. Header navigation uses subtle typographic scale and contrast on hover without background fills. Feature grids use complete equal-width rows without empty bento cells.

Dashboard direction 01 Precision selected. The production workspace uses a permanent 248px grouped sidebar, project-first hierarchy, compact flat surfaces, URL-synced sections, a mobile drawer, and honest empty states instead of invented metrics.

Primary navigation keeps fixed text geometry and animates only color and a transform-only underline. Language changes use a short root crossfade rather than replaying every page reveal. The home hero is a product-led runtime scene with no fake metrics or stock GTA artwork. Dashboard tools remain absent until an active license exists; the pre-purchase state is an honest product shelf with only Lifetime checkout wired and fixed-term/source access routed to discussion.
